_about: Three Grey Coats mission nodes (mission-framework TGC). Mission part only: validate with the Tallow Wharf map graph, `node scripts/level-validate.mjs <abs>/docs/missions/prototypes/campaign-map/graph.json <abs>/docs/missions/prototypes/three-grey-coats/graph.json` (mission-validator branch). Space ids are the map's (campaign-map/graph.json). Not validator fields: `target`, `decoys`, `bolt` on the interrogate step (MissionStep, PLAN 2; bolt = the clock-mender's back loft w2-clock-loft, A11) and the top-level `route` (the spaces both players use, highlighted in PLAN.svg). Beat chart: BEAT.md; renames and the W3 crossing: BEAT.md 'Graph notes'.

objectives.text: Find the three grey coats under the fish hall clock
objectives.hint: The fish hall clock is the tallest light in the market. The coats stand under it.

objectives.text: Learn which grey coat is Pell's: the warden's tally book, the tea stall talk
objectives.hint: Tally book: the warden's desk, gallery level. Tea stall: by the canal steps.

objectives.text: Take the grey coat with the black umbrella in the reading room loft
objectives.hint: He went up the arcade stair to the reading room loft. Climb, don't take the stair.

objectives.text: Optional: read Pell's courier rota in the pawnbroker's loft
objectives.hint: The lit desk beside the pawnbroker's walkway door. Fenn sits with his back to it.

objectives.text: Find the chest stencilled with a candle in shed three
objectives.hint: Shed three has the lit loading door. The chest has a candle stencilled on the lid.

objectives.text: Both of you, over the gangway to the boat under the crane
objectives.hint: The boat waits at the jetty under the crane. The gangway is the quiet way aboard. Both of you must be aboard.
